authority: CEO R324 §P3/§P4 — executable knowledge atoms + factory inheritance

KA-001.lesson: 1D hydraulic models adequate for straight pipe, inadequate for sudden contractions
KA-001.changed_design_rule: IF geometry has sudden area changes THEN require 3D solver (svMultiPhysics) from start. IF straight pipe THEN 1D acceptable.
KA-001.changed_experiment: For P-01 (straight pipe): 1D was sufficient (16% agreement). For FDA benchmark (nozzle): 1D failed (72% disagreement).

KA-004.lesson: Analytical optical approximations disagree 60-70% outside valid regime; MC required
KA-004.changed_design_rule: IF source-detector distance < 10*MFP THEN require Monte Carlo (PyTissueOptics or MCX). Analytical approximations (diffusion, Kubelka-Munk) are INSUFFICIENT.
KA-004.changed_experiment: P-16: switched from diffusion approximation to PyTissueOptics MC after R310 showed 60-70% disagreement.
KA-004.changed_simulator: optical → PyTissueOptics (CPU) or MCX (GPU). Never analytical alone.

KA-005.lesson: Metric validity (safety-ICP) matters more than raw drainage capacity
KA-005.changed_design_rule: METRIC_VALIDITY gate mandatory before any execution. Check: physical_meaning, clinical_relevance, comparator_sensitivity, failure_sensitivity. If any fails, redesign metric.
KA-005.changed_experiment: P-19 R313: drainage_capacity metric (1/10 discriminating) → R314: safety-ICP metric (9/10 discriminating).

KA-009.lesson: Distributed channels do NOT provide resilience beyond conductance matching
KA-009.changed_design_rule: BASELINE_CONDUCTANCE_MATCHING: IF comparing distributed vs single THEN must match baseline hydraulic conductance BEFORE applying obstruction. 1D Poiseuille matching is INSUFFICIENT — must verify through 3D solver.
KA-009.changed_experiment: P-19 R322: conductance-matched test showed single channel BEATS distributed. All future distributed candidates must pass this control.
KA-009.changed_simulator: distributed_vs_single comparison → svMultiPhysics (3D) mandatory. 1D cannot be trusted for this comparison.

hydraulic_candidates.enforcement: Candidate factory checks trigger_conditions before allowing experiment execution. If trigger matches, the corresponding design_rule is enforced as a prerequisite.

optical_candidates.enforcement: Optical candidates cannot use analytical approximations alone. MC (PyTissueOptics or MCX) is mandatory.

all_candidates_with_thresholds.enforcement: Every threshold must have: provenance (source + class), sensitivity test (frozen threshold varied across range), METRIC_VALIDITY gate.

all_candidates.enforcement: No candidate may execute without passing METRIC_VALIDITY gate.

how_inheritance_compounds.description: Each knowledge atom adds a prerequisite that future candidates must satisfy. The factory becomes stricter with every failure. P-19's falsification (KA-009) means no future distributed-channel candidate can skip conductance matching. P-16's analytical disagreement (KA-004) means no future optical candidate can use analytical approximations alone. P-19's metric flaw (KA-005) means no candidate can use an unvalidated metric.
how_inheritance_compounds.compound_effect: The 9 knowledge atoms collectively prevent the specific failure modes that were discovered. The factory is now harder to fool than it was at R312.
